description: This file implements the EventThread class and related factory functions for managing a thread that executes queued functions, including thread creation, shutdown, and synchronization mechanisms.

classes.name: IEventThreadFactory
classes.description: Interface for creating event thread factories.

classes.name: EventThreadFactory
classes.description: Concrete implementation of IEventThreadFactory that creates EventThread instances.

classes.name: EventThread
classes.description: Class managing a dedicated thread that executes queued functions, with support for thread naming, shutdown, and synchronization.

methods.name: createFactory
methods.description: Creates and returns a shared pointer to an IEventThreadFactory instance.

methods.name: createEventThread
methods.description: Creates a new EventThread with the specified thread name.

methods.name: EventThread
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the thread with a given name and starts execution.

methods.name: ~EventThread
methods.description: Destructor that signals shutdown and joins the thread.

methods.name: threadExecutor
methods.description: Main thread loop that executes queued functions and handles thread naming.

methods.name: flush
methods.description: Ensures all queued functions are executed by signaling via a semaphore.

methods.name: addImpl
methods.description: Adds a function to the queue for execution by the thread.
